scripts.test:rules: npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-nutri-scan "node tests/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.firebase:setup: npx -y firebase-tools@latest firestore:databases:create nutri-scan --location=asia-south1 --project ideathon-projects && npx -y firebase-tools@latest hosting:sites:create nutri-scan-ideathon --project ideathon-projects
scripts.deploy: npx -y firebase-tools@latest experiments:enable webframeworks && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting:nutri-scan-ideathon,firestore --project ideathon-projects
